Suffered a lower-body injury in the spring shortly after withdrawing from the transfer portal, and the program has treated it as a long-term issue. He is likely to miss the entire 2026 season after posting 109 receiving yards in 2025.

Started the first three games before the program announced ahead of the Sept. 26 Wake Forest game that a knee injury would end his season. The fifth-year defender led the team with three interceptions in 2025.

The punter has been listed as out with an undisclosed injury on every availability report since at least the Sept. 19 SMU game. He remains out for the Nov. 14 game at North Carolina with no timetable given.

Has been listed as out with an undisclosed injury on every availability report since at least the Sept. 19 SMU game. The tackle remains out for the Nov. 14 game at North Carolina with no timetable given.

The tackle missed the first two games, debuted against SMU on Sept. 19 and has been in and out of the lineup since with an undisclosed injury. He has been out since the Oct. 17 Syracuse game and stays out for the Nov. 14 game at North Carolina with no timetable.

The receiver  hurt his knee in the 34-26 win at Syracuse on Oct. 17, played through it, then missed the Stanford and Georgia Tech games after Jeff Brohm said he would be out an extended period. He is probable to return on Nov. 14 at North Carolina, well ahead of that outlook.

The freshman receiver was listed as out for the SMU and Wake Forest games in September, came off the report in October and returned to it ahead of Georgia Tech. He is out again for the Nov. 14 game at North Carolina with an undisclosed injury.

Went from probable to a game-time decision before the Nov. 7 game at Georgia Tech with an undisclosed injury, then played a reduced role in the 44-17 win. He is probable for the Nov. 14 game at North Carolina and has not missed a game this season.
New to the availability report this week with an undisclosed injury. The defensive lineman is probable for the Nov. 14 game at North Carolina.
Was listed as questionable with an undisclosed injury ahead of the Nov. 7 game at Georgia Tech. The defensive back is probable for the Nov. 14 game at North Carolina.

Has moved on and off the availability report all season, including the week of the Villanova game and after getting banged up against Florida State on Oct. 9. The lineman is probable for the Nov. 14 game at North Carolina.
